question: Should this protected prototype branch be preserved and restacked after the revised Claws RFC is accepted, or replaced by a new narrower diagnostics PR?
rationale: The concrete read-only defect is repairable, but current main has no Claws product surface and the RFC explicitly treats this stack as prototype evidence, so automation cannot decide whether this branch should remain the implementation vehicle.

options.title: Restack after RFC
options.body: Preserve this branch as source work, then rewrite it onto the accepted lifecycle model and read-only state contract before merge.

options.title: Accept prototype contract
options.body: Proceed with this branch only if maintainers explicitly own its experimental persistence, upgrade, and compatibility semantics.

options.title: Replace diagnostics slice
options.body: Pause or close this branch and create a narrower diagnostics PR after the lifecycle contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Restack after RFC
recommendation.body: Preserve this branch as source work, then rewrite it onto the accepted lifecycle model and read-only state contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Shared-state feature history and the protected repository-level lifecycle direction make this the strongest available decision owner.
